comment: Parameter 8, named Timer Max, has no ParamWidget on the panel, so no click can reach it and it gets no line, no tag and no props; nothing in process() reads it either. The shape knob snaps to five settings and the generator crossfades between adjacent shapes, so only the five named shapes are reachable from the panel (src/Runshow.cpp:125-165). A bar's envelope length is that bar's clock count times the measured gap between clocks, so it follows the tempo, while the two minute-based outputs are timed from std::chrono::steady_clock (src/Runshow.cpp:265).
